lake-huron-lightship-station.text: Lake Huron light vessel, No. 61, off the entrance to the St. Clair River, Michigan. - Moved, on the opening of navigation 1895, to a position 9,125 feet N. 19° 53' E. (N. by E. 3/4 E.) from Fort Gratiot light-house.
